Entity-Relationship Database Schema

PostgreSQL normalized schema separating Page identity from BrowsingEvent visit instances, with 13 entities, foreign keys, and indexes.

erDiagram

    users ||--o{ browsing_events : generates
    users ||--o{ conversations : creates
    users ||--o{ excluded_domains : configures
    users ||--o{ user_preferences : has
    users ||--o{ memory_deletions : requests

    browser_connections ||--o{ browsing_events : sources

    pages ||--o{ browsing_events : referenced_by

    browsing_sessions ||--o{ browsing_events : contains

    memory_topics ||--o{ page_topics : categorizes

    conversations ||--o{ conversation_messages : contains

    search_queries ||--o{ browsing_events : triggers

Index Target Index Structure Purpose
browsing_events(user_id, visited_at DESC) B-tree Index Sub-millisecond chronological pagination & timeline browsing
pages(to_tsvector(title || content_text)) PostgreSQL GIN Index High-speed full-text keyword retrieval matching
page_embeddings(embedding) pgvector HNSW / IVFFlat 1536-dimensional semantic similarity vector search
pages(url) Unique B-tree Global page identity separation & deduplication

Browser Extension Architecture & Pipeline

Manifest V3 event-driven pipeline designed for near-zero CPU and memory overhead with local resilience.

graph LR
    subgraph "Chrome Extension (MV3)"
        SW["Service Worker
(Event-driven, no infinite timers)"]
        POP["Popup UI
(Sync status, Token pairing, Pause)"]
    end

    subgraph "Core Extension Logic"
        OBS["Event Observer
(Debounced tabs.onUpdated > 2s)"]
        PRIV["Privacy Filter
(Excluded domains & credentials check)"]
        Q["Local Resilient Queue
(chrome.storage.local, max 500)"]
        BAT["Batch Sender
(Alarms: 30s interval OR 20 events)"]
        AUTH2["Auth Manager
(JWT Token Bearer)"]
    end

    SW --> OBS
    OBS --> PRIV
    PRIV -->|"Permitted Events"| Q
    Q --> BAT
    BAT -->|"POST /api/events/batch"| API2["Recall API"]
    POP --> AUTH2
    AUTH2 --> API2
    POP --> SW

Extension Execution Flow:

  1. User navigates to a webpage in Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.
  2. Service Worker captures lightweight metadata (URL, page title, timestamp).
  3. Privacy Filter executes synchronously: blocks passwords, forms, and domains matching the exclusion table.
  4. Permitted visits are added to chrome.storage.local with a 30s deduplication window.
  5. Batch Manager triggers every 30 seconds via chrome.alarms (or instantly when queue reaches 20 items).
  6. Events are POSTed to /api/events/batch and flushed from local storage on confirmation.
  7. If offline, events remain securely in local storage and retry with exponential backoff.

Retrieval Engine & Conversational RAG

Multi-signal hybrid retrieval engine translating natural, imperfect human memories into grounded AI answers with citations.

graph TB
    UQ["User Query
'that github repo about cuda memory from last week'"] --> QP["Query Intent Parser"]
    
    QP -->|"Extracts: 'last week'"| TF2["Time Filter (Sep 15 - Sep 22)"]
    QP -->|"Extracts: 'cuda memory'"| VS2["Vector Search (pgvector cosine)"]
    QP -->|"Extracts: 'cuda', 'memory'"| FTS2["Full-Text Keyword Search (ts_rank)"]
    QP -->|"Extracts: 'github.com'"| MF2["Domain & Metadata Filter"]

    TF2 --> CAND["Candidate Pool (Top 150)"]
    VS2 --> CAND
    FTS2 --> CAND
    MF2 --> CAND

    CAND --> RR["Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) + Scoring"]
    RR --> TOP2["Top K Ranked Memories (with Match Reasons)"]
    TOP2 --> CTX["Context Builder & Citation Formatter"]
    CTX --> LLM2["LLM Synthesis (Strict Grounding Prompt)"]
    LLM2 --> RESP["Grounded Answer + Verified Clickable Citations"]
Signal Weight Technical Mechanism Human Memory Mapping
Semantic Similarity 0.35 pgvector Cosine Distance "What was that concept about..."
Keyword Relevance 0.25 PostgreSQL ts_rank GIN "I remember the word 'cuda' and 'samples'..."
Temporal Proximity 0.20 Time Window Distance "...from last week or a few days ago"
Recency Decay 0.10 Exponential Decay Curve Favor newer discoveries when timing is unstated
Session Cohesion 0.10 Same Session Clustering Include other pages explored in the same session

Privacy & Security Model

Zero-trust architecture guaranteeing user ownership, client-side pre-filtering, and strict data isolation.

graph TD
    subgraph "Client Ingestion Filter (Extension)"
        RAW["Browser Navigation Event"] --> SENS{"Sensitive Pattern Check"}
        SENS -->|"Passwords / Forms / Cookies"| DROP1["❌ Instant Discard (Never Recorded)"]
        SENS -->|"Excluded Domain Match"| DROP2["❌ Blocked by Privacy Rule"]
        SENS -->|"Permitted Metadata"| STORE["✅ Queue in chrome.storage"]
    end

    subgraph "Server Storage & Retrieval Isolation"
        STORE -->|"Encrypted HTTPS Batch"| API3["Recall API Gateway"]
        API3 --> ROW{"Row-Level User Auth"}
        ROW -->|"user_id Scoped"| DB[("Private PostgreSQL Record")]
        ROW -->|"Cross-User Access Attempt"| REJECT["❌ 403 Forbidden"]
    end

    subgraph "User Governance"
        DB --> EXP["JSON Data Export (Portability)"]
        DB --> DEL["Individual / Date / Account Wipe"]
        DB --> PAUSE["Master Sync Pause Switch"]
    end
